home.companySubtitle: SERIVISI YA AUGU SMART ELECTRONIC · Kigali, Rwanda
home.heroTitle: Ubunararibonye mu Gusana Mudasobwa, Gushyiraho CCTV & Kwigisha IT
home.heroSubtitle: Kuva ku gusuzuma no gusana ibyuma bya mudasobwa na za printer, kugera ku gushyiraho camera z'umutekano za CCTV n'amahugurwa y'umwuga arimo kwimenyereza umwuga, dutanga ibisubizo byihuse kandi byizewe bifite ibiciro bisobanutse mbere yo gusana.
home.hoursText: Kuwa Mbere - Kuwa Gatanu · 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
home.offeringsSubtitle: Gusana mudasobwa by'umwuga, gushyiraho camera za CCTV, n'imiyoboro y'umurandasi bikorewe ibigo, amashuri, n'abantu ku giti cyabo i Kigali.
home.ctaTitle: Igikoresho cyawe cyagize ikibazo? Kizane uyu munsi.
home.ctaSubtitle: Gusuzuma ku buntu, kumenya igiciro mbere yo gutangira gusana, n'igihe kizaba cyakiriye neza.

services.title: Gusana, guhuza imiyoboro, umutekano no kwigisha
services.subtitle: Buri murimo wose utangirira ku gusuzuma neza no gutanga igiciro kiboneye. Reba serivisi zacu zose zo gusana mudasobwa, gushyiraho camera za CCTV, imiyoboro ya interineti, gusana printer n'amahugurwa y'umwuga.
services.freeDiagnosticNote: Gusuzuma no kugena igiciro ku buntu kuri buri busabe
services.customRequirementsDesc: Dukora imishinga yihariye y'ikoranabuhanga, gutegura amashuri ya mudasobwa, gushyiraho za server n'imiyoboro migari ya camera za CCTV. Twandikire tugusure ku buntu tubigenere igiciro.

training.badge: Inzira y'Umwuga · Amahugurwa Ngiro ya IT & Kwimenyereza
training.title: Iga IT ku bikoresho bifatika, atari mu magambo gusa
training.subtitle: Kwimenyereza tekiniki nyayo mu buryo bw'ingiro i Kigali. Kora imirimo y'ingiro yo gusuzuma mudasobwa, gushyiraho no guhuza camera za CCTV, gutegura imiyoboro y'ibigo, kandi usoze ufite icyemezo cy'amashuri.
training.smallCohort: Itsinda rito ry'abanyeshuri · Imyanya irabaze kuri buri cyiciro
training.formSubtitle: Ohereza umwirondoro wawe maze ushinzwe amahugurwa azaguhamagara kugira ngo yemeze umwanya wawe n'amatariki yo gutangira.

contact.title: Vugana n'umutekinisiye uyu munsi
contact.subtitle: Duhamagare, twandikire kuri WhatsApp cyangwa utwoherereze ibisobanuro by'ikibazo ufite. Dusubiza mu masaha y'akazi, kuwa mbere kugeza kuwa gatanu.
contact.formSubtitle: Ohereza ubusabe bwawe muri sisitemu yacu cyangwa uduhamagare kuri WhatsApp.
contact.messagePlaceholder: Sobanura ikibazo igikoresho cyawe gifite cyangwa uko wifuza ko bikorwa...
contact.successSent: Urakoze! Ubutumwa bwawe bwoherejwe neza. Turakuvugisha mu masaha 24.

about.title: Aho dukorera hashingiye ku gusuzuma mu bunyangamugayo
about.subtitle: AUGU SMART ELECTRONIC SERVICE LTD, izwi ku izina rya Computer Universe, ikorera ingo, amaduka n'ibiro i Kigali kuva ku cyicaro cyacu giherereye Norvege, Karama.
about.storyP1: Twatangiye dufite ameza yo gusaniraho, icyuma gisudira n'ihame rimwe ryoroshye: kubwiza umukiriya ukuri ku kibazo igikoresho gifite mbere yo kumuca amafaranga ayo ari yo yose. Iryo hame ryatugejeje ku kuba ikigo gisana mudasobwa, printer, imiyoboro y'ibiro na camera za CCTV mu Karere ka Nyarugenge n'ahandi hose.
about.storyP2: Uyu munsi dufatanya imirimo yo gusana n'ikigo cy'amahugurwa aho abimenyereza umwuga bakora ku byuma nyabyo. Twizera ko ubumenyi ngiro no kuvugana mu kuri ari byo byonyine byubaka icyizere kirambye mu gukora no gusana ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga.
about.step1Desc: Dusuzuma igikoresho cyangwa ahashyirwa ibikoresho mbere yo kuvuga igiciro.
about.step2Desc: Uhabwa igiciro kirambuye n'igihe bizafata, maze ukifatira icyemezo.
about.step3Desc: Akazi gakorerwa mu kigo cyacu cyangwa aho uri, hifashishijwe ibyuma by'umwimerere.
about.trust1: Raporo isobanutse y'isuzuma mbere yo gufungura ibyuma
about.trust3: Kwimenyereza mu buryo bw'ingiro bitanga abatekinisiye bafite impamyabumenyi
about.trust4: Umurongo utaziguye wa WhatsApp wo kuvugana n'umutekinisiye urimo kugusanira

gallery.title: Ibimenyetso by'ibikorerwa mu kigo n'aho dutumwe
gallery.subtitle: Uburyo bwo gusuzuma nyabwo, gusudira amakarita ya mudasobwa (motherboard), gushyiraho camera za CCTV, n'abanyeshuri barimo kwimenyereza i Kigali.
gallery.empty: Nta mafoto araboneka muri iki cyiciro muri aka kanya.
